notes: Source of truth for the plugin catalog. `app/db/seed.py` loads this into SQLite.
price_usd is approximate full MSRP in USD, captured for tiering only — vendors discount heavily and often, so verify before showing a price as fact.
tier follows the spec: FREE, MID ($30-100), PREMIUM ($100+).
purchase_url points at the vendor rather than a deep product link, because product URLs rot.
rating is an editorial pick strength (0-5) used to rank candidates within a tier and category. It is not a review score.
A plugin that genuinely does two jobs (TDR Nova as both EQ and de-esser) appears once per category; (name, category) is the key.

plugins.name: TDR Nova
plugins.why: A dynamic parallel EQ for free — it can cut a resonance only when the resonance is actually there

plugins.name: MEqualizer
plugins.why: Clean six-band EQ with a usable analyser, free in the MFreeFXBundle

plugins.name: ReaEQ
plugins.why: Unlimited bands, no nonsense, runs on anything

plugins.name: Voxengo Marvel GEQ
plugins.why: 16-band graphic EQ for broad tonal moves rather than surgery

plugins.name: TDR Nova GE
plugins.why: The paid Nova adds wider bands, better metering and oversampling — the best value dynamic EQ there is

plugins.name: TDR VOS SlickEQ GE
plugins.why: Broad, musical curves with console-style saturation baked in — for tone, not for surgery

plugins.name: Waves Renaissance Equalizer
plugins.why: Smooth analogue-flavoured curves that flatter a thin vocal

plugins.name: FabFilter Pro-Q 4
plugins.why: The reference vocal EQ: dynamic bands, spectrum grab, linear phase when you need it

plugins.name: oeksound soothe2
plugins.why: Tracks and ducks resonances as they move, which is what harshness actually does

plugins.name: Soundtheory Gullfoss
plugins.why: Continuously rebalances the spectrum — good at unmasking a vocal that keeps getting buried

plugins.name: TDR Kotelnikov
plugins.why: Clean, program-dependent compression that holds a vocal down without audibly squashing it

plugins.name: Klanghelm DC1A
plugins.why: Two knobs, immediately flattering — the fastest way to get a bedroom vocal under control

plugins.name: MCompressor
plugins.why: Fully adjustable and metered, free in the MFreeFXBundle

plugins.name: Klanghelm DC8C 3
plugins.why: Does clean, coloured and aggressive from one window — the most flexible cheap vocal compressor

plugins.name: Klanghelm MJUC
plugins.why: Variable-mu warmth that thickens a thin take while it levels it

plugins.name: Waves Vocal Rider
plugins.why: Rides the fader instead of compressing, so a wildly uneven take keeps its transients

plugins.name: TDR Kotelnikov GE
plugins.why: Adds sidechain filtering and delta listening to an already excellent compressor

plugins.name: FabFilter Pro-C 2
plugins.why: Eight styles including a dedicated vocal mode, with the clearest gain-reduction display in the business

plugins.name: Softube Tube-Tech CL 1B MK2
plugins.why: The opto compressor most modern vocal records lean on; forgiving and thick

plugins.name: Sonnox Oxford Dynamics
plugins.why: Compressor, gate, expander and limiter in one, all on the same detector

plugins.name: Lisp
plugins.why: Tracks the sibilant band automatically, so it keeps working as the singer moves

plugins.name: TDR Nova
plugins.why: A dynamic band over the ess region is a de-esser, and this one shows you exactly what it is doing

plugins.name: Spitfish
plugins.why: Ancient, 32-bit on some systems, still effective on a single obvious ess problem

plugins.name: Techivation T-De-Esser Pro
plugins.why: Adaptive detection with a wide-band mode that avoids the lisping a hard split-band can cause

plugins.name: Waves Sibilance
plugins.why: Organic-sounding resynthesis approach; very hard to make it lisp

plugins.name: FabFilter Pro-DS
plugins.why: Single-vocal and allround modes, audition filters, and it simply never lisps

plugins.name: oeksound soothe2
plugins.why: Handles esses and the harshness around them as one problem, which is usually what it is

plugins.name: Softube Saturation Knob
plugins.why: One knob, three tilt modes — keep it on 'Neutral' and drive it gently

plugins.name: Klanghelm IVGI
plugins.why: Level-dependent grit that stays subtle even when pushed

plugins.name: Voxengo Tube Amp
plugins.why: Simple asymmetric tube-style drive for adding harmonics up top

plugins.name: Klanghelm SDRR2
plugins.why: Four saturation flavours with a bias control — the cheapest way to get real analogue-style thickness

plugins.name: Soundtoys Little Radiator
plugins.why: Tube console colour that thickens the midrange of a thin take

plugins.name: Soundtoys Decapitator
plugins.why: Five analogue models with a tone control; the go-to for making a vocal cut without EQ

plugins.name: FabFilter Saturn 2
plugins.why: Multiband saturation, so you can add presence up top without muddying the body

plugins.name: ReaGate
plugins.why: Proper hysteresis and a filtered detector, which is what stops a gate chattering on breaths

plugins.name: MGate
plugins.why: Visual gate with sidechain filtering, free in the MFreeFXBundle

plugins.name: Waves C1 Compressor
plugins.why: Gate, expander and compressor sharing a filtered sidechain — good for noisy takes

plugins.name: FabFilter Pro-G

plugins.name: ReaFIR
plugins.why: Learns the noise profile from a silent passage and subtracts it — free spectral denoise that actually works

plugins.name: Bertom Denoiser Classic
plugins.why: No profile to learn, one amount knob, very few artifacts at gentle settings

plugins.name: Waves Clarity Vx
plugins.why: Neural separation of voice from everything else; excellent on room tone and hiss

plugins.name: Acon Digital DeVerberate 3
plugins.why: Splits direct sound from reverb tail, so you can pull a bedroom room print down

plugins.name: Waves NS1 Noise Suppressor

plugins.name: iZotope RX 11 Standard
plugins.why: The repair standard: spectral denoise, de-hum, de-click and de-reverb in one place

plugins.name: Accentize DeRoom Pro
plugins.why: The most convincing de-reverb for an untreated room, with per-band control

plugins.name: Zynaptiq UNVEIL

plugins.name: Graillon 2 Free
plugins.why: Musical pitch correction plus a pitch-shift voice, and the free version is genuinely usable

plugins.name: MAutoPitch
plugins.why: Scale-aware correction with formant preservation and a width control

plugins.name: GSnap
plugins.why: The original free auto-tune; fine for gentle correction, obvious when pushed

plugins.name: Waves Tune Real-Time

plugins.name: Celemony Melodyne 5 Essential

plugins.name: Antares Auto-Tune Pro X

plugins.name: Celemony Melodyne 5 Studio

plugins.name: Valhalla Supermassive

plugins.name: OrilRiver
plugins.why: The best free algorithmic room reverb; sensible early-reflection control

plugins.name: TAL-Reverb-4

plugins.name: Valhalla VintageVerb

plugins.name: Valhalla Room

plugins.name: Soundtoys Little Plate

plugins.name: FabFilter Pro-R 2

plugins.name: Eventide Blackhole

plugins.name: Valhalla Freq Echo

plugins.name: TAL-Dub-3
